== Description ==
'''UI-173''' is the 8th entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

== Behavior ==
When '''UI-173''' spawns, it will play the composition known as "Horror Race", like all the other entities that reside within the I-Section. If there are more entities present, it will play the same song but with a higher pitch and speed.

'''UI-173''' will appear at the front, rushing back after 3 seconds at a speed comparable to that of [[UI-110]]

== Strategy & Tips ==
Hide immediately when you see/Hear him

== Trivia ==
* Like most UI entities, '''UI-173''' was added as a joke.
